How to read the atlas

Amber arrows show negative-labeled links sent by the selected subreddit. Violet arrows point toward it. The map highlights the strongest visible counterparts, while the list includes all counterparts in the selected period.

The timeline uses UTC months. Negative fractions in the dossier use all link rows for the specified direction as the denominator. Repeat links count separately.

Embedding positions use a two-dimensional PCA projection when SNAP data is loaded. Communities without vectors can still be explored through the timeline and list. The built-in dataset uses fictional communities and illustrative link counts.
